As reported by users, the API sometimes times out while loading the integration for the first time and after manually reloading it works fine:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/101812

issue_context.title: AEMET Integration randomly would stop syncing (raise asyncio.TimeoutError from None)
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The integration has been setup for long time.
After upgrading to 2023.10 release it randomly stops working. Not always but must of the times on HA restart.

Reloading manually the integration after it shows as failed makes it work again.


### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.10.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2023.09.X

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

aemet

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/aemet

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
UI setup.
```
